question: A man has to cover a distance of 519 km in 7 hours. If he covers two-third of his distance in 5/7 of the time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining distance = 1 − 2/3 = 1/3 of total distance

Remaining time = 1 − 5/7 = 2/7 of total time

Remaining distance = 519 × 1/3 = 173 km

Remaining time = 7 × 2/7 = 2 hours

Required speed = 173 ÷ 2 = 86.5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 86.5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 519 km

Total time = 7 hours

 
 Part 1 (2/3)

 Total Distance = 519 km, Total Time = 7 hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered initially = 519 × 2/3 = 346 km

⇒ Time taken initially = 7 × 5/7 = 5 hours

⇒ Remaining distance = 519 − 346 = 173 km

⇒ Remaining time = 7 − 5 = 2 hours

⇒ Speed for remaining distance = 173 ÷ 2

⇒ Required speed = 86.5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 86.5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is defined as the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). When moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Conversion of Units

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
